pages.text: From day 10, some nights pillagers and vindicators come at players near a village, in up to six waves. It never falls on a special moon.$(br2)Kill one and hold out till dawn for two minutes of Hero of the Village.
pages.title: Pillager Siege

pages.text: The siege captain leads the last wave. He has a 1 in 4 chance to drop the Fundamentum music disc.
